[[File:Yuta.png|thumb|200px|Yuta]]
(Japanese: '''ユウタ''' ''Yūta'') is a character from the [[Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!]] manga.

==History==
Yuta appeared in ''[[GDZ21|Pokémon Hot Springs, Hot-Hot Battle]]'', where he caught an {{p|Ekans}} in the hot spring where [[Shu]] was relaxing. When the duo attempted to take over the hot springs, he attempted to battle Shu using {{p|Magmar}}. It took a majority of Shu's team to take them on, until {{p|Diglett}}'s {{m|Earthquake}} placed Magmar in a hot spring of its own. After Magmar found the hot springs, Yuta apologized for his actions and was subsequently chased by Magmar.
